The Ground Truth Answer asserts that Charles Hoskinson co-founded Ethereum and founded Cardano, with Cardano released in 2017 and Ethereum in 2015, and states that two years elapsed between the two releases. The essential information from the Ground Truth Answer—who the individual is, what platforms were released, the years/dates involved, and the elapsed time—is all present in the Predicted Answer, and with greater precision (the exact date difference is calculated).
